title: Correct SUNSTUDY DXF date and hour field mapping
scope: Correct the standalone SUNSTUDY DXF parser/writer mapping for date counts, hour counts, and seconds since midnight. This does not qualify physical DWG producer coverage, source graph closure, adapter output, or native scene semantics.

implementation.parser: Group 91 now sets only the bounded date count. Group 73 sets the bounded hour count; following group-290 values are consumed against that exact count. Group-90 time values are parsed as seconds and converted to the model's milliseconds with overflow and negative-value refusal.
implementation.writer: The date count remains group 91; hour count is emitted as signed-short group 73. Model milliseconds are converted to whole DXF seconds. Values with subsecond precision are refused before record output to avoid lossy serialization. Existing signed-short field bounds and finite spacing checks remain enforced.

focusedCTest.result: PASS, 1/1; generated ASCII and Binary output, exact group values, typed date/hour readback, subsecond refusal with destination preservation, corrected fresh-writer retry

limitations: The mapping is proven against the Autodesk DXF field table and locally generated vectors; it does not establish physical producer prevalence or source-to-output graph closure.
Subsecond DWG times have no lossless carrier in the documented integer DXF field and remain refused by this writer profile.
Strict dwg2dxf output continues to refuse retained SUNSTUDY until physical source, owner/reference closure, and adapter output are qualified.
Native sun-study rendering and plotting semantics remain unqualified.
